openIssues.scope: Open issues, compared against open and closed PRs in this repository
openIssues.criterion: No corresponding implementation PR identified. Incidental documentation, QA, bug-filing, and explicitly unrelated PR references are excluded. Partial implementing PRs count as corresponding PRs.
openIssues.method: Enumerated all 315 enyst issues, 22 smolpaws issues, 585 enyst PRs and 24 smolpaws PRs. Compared exact issue references in PR titles and bodies; reviewed reference contexts and selected issue discussions/PR searches. GitHub timeline absence alone was not used as proof.
openIssues.limitations: A PR without an issue reference may be missed. The counts are findings from this search, not proof that no unlinked implementation exists. Closed issue matches exist too, but are not exhaustively classified in this open-issue CSV.
